messages.text: Ordered a DC08 miner, received a Thor P2...
Handed to the team · return_order.py and rma_replacement.py both refuse without the rma-approved tag;

Sorry about that, Zach. Your order was a Hammer DC08, and the warehouse put a Thor P2 in the box. That's our mistake, not yours.

The fix is a prepaid return label for the Thor P2 at no cost to you, with Shop···· written on the outside, and the DC08 you paid for going out to you. I've got that queued with the reference and the label sorted, but the sign-off happens in the morning: the team picks it up at 10am ET and the label comes to this email address.

Please keep the Thor P2 boxed until then.

That's the one, Zach, Shop····. Nothing more needed from you on it.

The T. P2 goes back on a prepaid label with Shop···· on the box, at no cost to you, and your DC08 comes out to you. The label lands in your email once the team opens at 10am ET tomorrow.

Keep the Thor P2 in its box until the label arrives. Anything else I can check on it in the meantime?
Before you go, one thing: what made you add the Harlo OS Diagnostics + RMA plan to the order?
It came with it as far as im aware, but everyone says you have to flash Harlo onto it yourself anyhow
Where did you hear that about flashing it yourself, a forum, a video, somewhere else?

Thanks, that's useful to know.

When your DC08 lands, firmware and release notes live at harlolabs.com, and our own Discord is at discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf if you want a hand setting it up. JD (@nullhashrate) is in there most days.

Watch your email for that return label.
